```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
sf_use_s2(F)

```

```{r}

pth <- here::here('side_projs', 'reports')

fn_gif <- function(plots, f_out, w = 6.5, h = 5){
  
  plots |> 
    iwalk(\(p, i){
      
      ggsave(plot = p, 
             width = w, 
             height = h,
             filename = str_glue("{pth}/tmp_{i}.png"))
      
    })
  
  str_glue("convert -delay 120 {pth}/tmp_*.png {pth}/{f_out}") |> 
  system()
  
  fs::dir_ls(pth, regexp = "tmp_") |> 
    fs::file_delete()
  
}


land_pol <- 
  "/mnt/bucket_mine/misc_data/physical/ne_110m_land/" |> 
  st_read(quiet = T)

land_df <- 
  land_pol %>% 
  st_coordinates %>% 
  as_tibble %>% 
  mutate(L = paste0(L1, "_", L2))

v01 <- 
  "/mnt/bucket_mine/results/global_heat_pf/03_mosaicked/water/v3/change-dry-hot-days_v3-01.nc" |>  
  read_mdim() |> 
  st_crop(land_pol)

v03 <- 
  "/mnt/bucket_mine/results/global_heat_pf/03_mosaicked/water/v3/change-dry-hot-days_v3-03.nc" |>  
  read_mdim() |> 
  st_crop(land_pol)

dif <- v01 - v03

```

```{r}


plots <- 
  map2(list(v01, v03), c("Version 1", "Version 3"), \(s, v){
    
    tb <- 
      s |> 
      select(3) |> 
      slice(wl, 1) |> 
      as_tibble()
    
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(data = tb, aes(lon, lat, fill = perc50)) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-55, 75), xlim = c(-155, 160)) +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "bottom") +
      labs(title = "Dry Hot Days [0.5° WL]",
           subtitle = v) +
      colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_sequential("plasma",
                                                   na.value = "transparent",
                                                   guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = 0.5,
                                                                          barwidth = 24,
                                                                          title.position = "left"),
                                                   name = "days",
                                                   rev = T,
                                                   limits = c(0, 35),
                                                   breaks = scales::breaks_width(5),
                                                   oob = scales::squish)
    
  })

fn_gif(plots, "anim1.gif")

```
![](anim1.gif)

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 5

tb <- 
  dif |> 
  select(3) |> 
  slice(wl, 1) |> 
  as_tibble() 
  
lims <- quantile(tb$perc50, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = T)
ext <- range(tb$perc50, na.rm = T)  

ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = tb, aes(lon, lat, fill = perc50)) +
  geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-55, 75), xlim = c(-155, 160)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Dry Hot Days [0.5° WL]",
       subtitle = "Difference v1 - v3: blue (red) = v1 more (less) days than v3",
       caption = str_glue("Extreme vals: {ext[1]} - +{ext[2]}")) +
  colorspace::scale_fill_binned_diverging(na.value = "transparent",
                                          n.breaks = 7,
                                          guide = guide_colorsteps(barheight = 0.5,
                                                                   barwidth = 24,
                                                                   title.position = "left"),
                                          name = "days  ",
                                          rev = T,
                                          limits = c(lims[1], lims[2]),
                                          oob = scales::squish
  )

```

```{r}


tb <- 
  dif |> 
  select(3) |> 
  slice(wl, c(2,3,4,6)) |> 
  as_tibble()
  
lims <- quantile(tb$perc50, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = T)
ext <- range(tb$perc50, na.rm = T)

ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = tb, aes(lon, lat, fill = perc50)) +
  geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
  facet_wrap(~wl, nrow = 2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-55, 75), xlim = c(-155, 160)) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Change in Dry Hot Days",
       subtitle = "Difference v1 - v3: blue (red) = v1 dries faster (slower) than v3",
       caption = str_glue("Extreme vals: {ext[1]} - +{ext[2]}")
       ) +
  colorspace::scale_fill_binned_diverging(na.value = "transparent",
                                          n.breaks = 7,
                                          guide = guide_colorsteps(barheight = 0.5,
                                                                   barwidth = 24,
                                                                   title.position = "left"),
                                          name = "days  ",
                                          rev = T,
                                          limits = c(lims[1], lims[2]),
                                          oob = scales::squish
  )

```

```{r}

plots <- 
  map2(list(v01, v03), c("Version 1", "Version 3"), \(s, v){
    
    tb <- 
      s |> 
      select(3) |> 
      slice(wl, c(2,3,4,6)) |> 
      as_tibble() |> 
      mutate(p = cut(perc50, c(-Inf, 0, 20, 40, 60, Inf)))
    
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(data = tb, aes(lon, lat, fill = p)) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      facet_wrap(~wl, nrow = 2) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-55, 75), xlim = c(-155, 160)) +
      theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
            legend.position = "bottom") +
      labs(title = "Change in Dry Hot Days",
           subtitle = v
      ) +
      colorspace::scale_fill_discrete_sequential("lajolla",
                                                 na.value = "transparent",
                                                 labels = c("0", "7", "30", "60"),
                                                 guide = guide_colorsteps(barheight = 0.5,
                                                                          barwidth = 24,
                                                                          title.position = "left"),
                                                 name = "days  ",
                                                 rev = F)
    
  })


fn_gif(plots, "anim2.gif")

```
![](anim2.gif)

```{r}

dir_data <- "/mnt/pers_disk/results/"

ff <-
  dir_data |>
  fs::dir_ls(regexp = "GLOBAL")

s_0p5 <-
  ff[1] |>
  read_mdim() |>
  # st_downsample(c(1, 1)) |>
  units::drop_units() |>
  st_crop(land_pol)

tb_0p5 <-
  s_0p5 |>
  as_tibble()

plots <-
  map(c("perc_98", "perc_99", "perc_100"), \(perc) {
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(
        data = tb_0p5,
        aes(lon, lat, fill = .data[[perc]])
      ) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        limits = quantile(tb_0p5 |> pull(.data[[perc]]), c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE),
        oob = scales::squish,
        na.value = "transparent",
        name = "mm",
        breaks = scales::breaks_width(100),
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barheight = 0.5,
          barwidth = 24,
          title.position = "left" 
        )
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-55, 75), xlim = c(-155, 160)) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = str_glue("{str_sub(perc, 6)}th percentile [0.5° WL]"))
  })


fn_gif(plots, "anim3.gif")

```
![](anim3.gif)

tb_0p5_sub <-
  tb_0p5 |>
  filter(lon <= -75, lon >= -101) |>
  filter(lat <= 50, lat >= 24)

plots <-
  map(c("perc_98", "perc_99", "perc_100"), \(perc) {
    
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(
        data = tb_0p5_sub,
        aes(lon, lat, fill = .data[[perc]])
      ) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        limits = quantile(tb_0p5_sub |> pull(.data[[perc]]), c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE),
        oob = scales::squish,
        na.value = "transparent",
        name = "mm",
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barheight = 0.5,
          barwidth = 24,
          title.position = "left"
        )
      ) +
      coord_equal(expand = F, xlim = c(-101, -75), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = str_glue("{str_sub(perc, 6)}th percentile [0.5° WL]"))
    
  })

fn_gif(plots, "anim4.gif")

```{r}

s_3p0 <-
  ff[6] |>
  read_mdim() |>
  units::drop_units() |>
  st_crop(land_pol)

tb_3p0 <-
  s_3p0 |>
  as_tibble()

tb_3p0_sub <-
  tb_3p0 |>
  filter(lon <= -75, lon >= -101) |>
  filter(lat <= 50, lat >= 24)


tb <- 
  full_join(
    tb_0p5_sub |> 
      select(lon, lat, "0.5" = perc_100),
    tb_3p0_sub |> 
      select(lon, lat, "3.0" = perc_100)
  )

plots <- 
  map(c("0.5", "3.0"), \(perc) {
    
    ext <- round(max(tb |> pull({{perc}}), na.rm = T))
    
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(
        data = tb,
        aes(lon, lat, fill = .data[[perc]])
      ) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(
        limits = quantile(tb |> pull(.data[[perc]]), c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE),
        oob = scales::squish,
        na.value = "transparent",
        name = "mm",
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barheight = 0.5,
          barwidth = 24,
          title.position = "left"
        )
      ) +
      coord_equal(expand = F, xlim = c(-101, -75), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_blank()) +
      labs(subtitle = str_glue("{perc}°C WL"),
           title = "100th percentile",
           caption = str_glue("Max: {ext}"))
    
  })

fn_gif(plots, "anim8.gif")


```

plots <-

    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(
        data = tb_dif_sub,
        aes(lon, lat, fill = .data[[perc]])
      ) +

      colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(
        limits = quantile(tb_dif_sub |> pull(.data[[perc]]), c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE),
        oob = scales::squish,
        na.value = "transparent",
        name = "mm",
        rev = T,
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barheight = 0.5,
          barwidth = 24,
          title.position = "left"
        )
      ) +

      labs(title = str_glue("{str_sub(perc, 6)}th percentile"),

  })

```{r}

storm <- 
  "/mnt/bucket_mine/results/global_heat_pf/03_mosaicked/water/v3/change-precip-100yr-storm_v03.nc" |> 
  read_mdim() |> 
  st_crop(land_pol)

tb_dif <-
  as_tibble(s_0p5 - (storm |> slice(wl, 1) |> st_warp(s_0p5) |> setNames("storm")))

tb_dif_sub <-
  tb_dif |>
  filter(lon <= -75, lon >= -101) |>
  filter(lat <= 50, lat >= 24)

plots <-
  map(c("perc_98", "perc_99", "perc_100"), \(perc) {
    
    ggplot() +
      geom_raster(
        data = tb_dif_sub,
        aes(lon, lat, fill = .data[[perc]])
      ) +
      geom_path(data = land_df, aes(X, Y, group = L), linewidth = 0.25) +
      colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(
        limits = quantile(tb_dif_sub |> pull(.data[[perc]]), c(0.02, 0.98), na.rm = TRUE),
        oob = scales::squish,
        na.value = "transparent",
        name = "mm",
        rev = T,
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barheight = 0.5,
          barwidth = 24,
          title.position = "left"
        )
      ) +
      coord_equal(expand = F, xlim = c(-101, -75), ylim = c(24, 50)) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.title = element_blank()) +
      labs(title = "Difference with 100-yr storm [0.5° WL]",
           subtitle = str_glue("{str_sub(perc, 6)}th percentile - 100-yr storm:\nblue (red) = percentile map more (less) days than storm map"))
    
  })

fn_gif(plots, "anim6.gif")

```
